column1: # ZZZ upstream absorbed ledger (classes A and B).
# One row per upstream commit ZZZ classified A or B: the decision
# to absorb it, and whether local history can prove it happened.
# The skipped half of each batch is in upstream-rejected.tsv; a SHA
# appears in exactly one of the two files.
# verify is one of: verified, equivalent, unverified, unknown.
# verified   - an absorbed-commit trailer in local history names this SHA
# equivalent - the batch found the local tree already matched upstream,
#              so no local commit carries a trailer
# unverified - the batch recorded the decision, but nothing proves it
# unknown    - the row predates the newest 3 absorbing batches
